Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JNJ.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 58 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2023.
Our gross margin expanded by 169 basis points to 52.2%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $26.2 billion this quarter, representing 9% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 27% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
